author: CBR
description:
This Short breaks down the take that M. Night Shyamalan may have made the best superhero trilogy while the MCU dominated movies and TV. It compares Marvel’s long run as the superhero gold standard with the argument for Unbreakable, Split, and Glass as a stronger, more complete trilogy. If you’re into MCU debates, superhero movies, and M. Night Shyamalan’s most underrated work, this is the big claim at the center of the conversation.
